content:
Returns a list of available AWS cloudtrails. You can then use the cloudtrails to create an AWS
connector.
Requires the Administrator [64] user role. See Roles.
AUTHORIZATIONS:
cloud
REQUEST BODY SCHEMA:
application/json
Array of objects
region
Content type
Content type
A complete list of available AWS regions.
object
The credentials that the Tenable Vulnerability Management connector uses
to communicate with the AWS API, including access_key  and
secret_key .
string
For keyless AWS connectors, the AWS account ID.
